notes.title: Visual Update!!
notes.content: Progress has been a little slow, but we've revamped some of the visuals! Less particles and more animations means MUCH less lag if you had that issue before. The fourth boss has had a major upgrade in function and patterns so its a lot more enjoyable to fight. Other small bug fixes and a control layout in the settings menu have been added. 3 more levels are in the works at the moment so be expecting those soon!
